summary: Bug: Paid Work Orders display incorrect totals in the Work Orders list
reported_issue: When filtering Work Orders by status = Paid, the Price Total shown in the Work Orders list did not match the total shown under the Financial Info section / Finance tab of the same WO (reported on a WO with no parts).
expected_after_fix: The Price Total in the Work Orders list matches the WO's Finance/Financial-Info total for Paid work orders, including WOs with no parts.
steps_i_followed: Loaded the Work Orders list (GET /api/work-orders?limit=100) which returns the same totalPrice the list UI renders.
Filtered to status = paid (25 Paid WOs present).

For 12 Paid WOs, opened each via GET /api/work-orders/view/{id} and compared the list totalPrice (cents/100) against the WO detail total_cost (the value shown in Financial Info / Finance tab), including several no-parts WOs (S9-24656, S2-23635, S9-23525, S2-23459, S9-24604, S9-24354).
actual_now: For every Paid WO checked the list Price Total equals the WO Finance total exactly (0 mismatches / 12), including no-parts WOs: e.g. S9-24656 list 1348.39 = view 1348.39, S9-24604 list 2696.77 = view 2696.77, S2-23635 list 130.48 = view 130.48. A broader all-status sweep of 18 more WOs also showed 0 mismatches.
notes: The list totalPrice is exactly the figure the Work Orders list renders, so an API-level match is authoritative for this display-consistency bug. No-parts Paid WOs (the ticket's specific case) match.
